name: Skittering Dark
summary: In western Silverpine, Skittering Dark lies abandoned beneath a web of danger. Giant spiders fill the mine and nearby woods, hunting unwary beasts and travelers.

sections.title: A Webbed Hollow
sections.body: The Skittering Dark lies east of North Tide's Run, where the western coast meets the hills. Once a working mine, its shafts now lie choked with cobwebs and serve as a sprawling nest for giant spiders. Krethis haunts the shadowed woods outside, while the spiders hunt anything that strays too close.

faq.answer: Skittering Dark is an abandoned mine in western Silverpine Forest, overrun by giant spiders. Webbing and predatory spiders fill the cavern network and the surrounding trees.

faq.q: Who leads the spiders in the mine?
faq.answer: No single ruler of the brood is known. Krethis Shadowspinner is the most feared spider, a rare and dangerous weaver that prowls in and around the mine.

faq.q: Where is the Skittering Dark located?
faq.answer: Skittering Dark lies in western Silverpine Forest, against the hills just east of North Tide's Run.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler in Silverpine, watch for spiders that ambush unwary prey straying from the surrounding woods into their webbed dens.
